مُرْقِدٌ A medicine that causes him who drinks it to sleep (S, K. [In a copy of the A ↓ مُرَقِّدٌ ; and thus pronounced in the present day.]) ―
-b2- Also A conspicuous road: (JK, K;) thus on the authority of As; but ISd says, “ I know not how it is: ” and others say that it is ↓ مُرَقِّدٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
